name: GitHub Dark Dimmed
tagline: The same GitHub, with the lights brought up off black and the contrast deliberately let down.
notes: Dimmed is the only variant that moves the canvas rather than the ink: #212830 instead of #0d1117, which costs roughly a third of every contrast ratio in the palette.

contrast_exempt.accent: Dimmed lifts the canvas to #212830, which costs every ratio in the palette; GitHub ships this link colour below AA and lightening it here would mean shipping a link colour GitHub does not have (measures 4.33:1)
contrast_exempt.muted: ANSI 8 is GitHub's own dimmed-text value and dimmed text is supposed to recede; lifting it would mean shipping a terminal palette GitHub does not have (measures 2.81:1)
contrast_exempt.brown: as above -- 'severe' is unchanged from the default dark theme and only looks worse because the paper got lighter (measures 4.04:1)
